why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Josh Jung is slot #5 (4.355 expected team runs/game).
Slots #5, #7, #8, #6, #4, #9, #3, #2, #1 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #2 ranks 8 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.007 R/G.
Slot #5 yields 4.22 expected PA/game vs 4.54 at primary slot #2. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
